nom: RODAN + FIELDS Hydra Mask Gel Cream with Peptides for Overnight Barrier Repair

avis.texte: I like the product. I've used it before. I don't think it feels as cool to the skin as the first one i had.
I love how this product feels on my face. It is very light weight and hydrates throughout the night.

I love this mask as it really hydrates my skin and gives you a clear glowing complexion. The only thing I have been disappointing is how long it took me to receive this product almost 2 weeks. Rodan and Fields needs to look into better shipping that doesn't take 2 weeks for delivery.
I love this product. . . my skin feels wonderful in the morning
I like the Hydro mask gel cream very much! I apply it at night and it moisturizes my skin very deeply, so that in the morning it looks still fresh and moist.
I use this daily and it makes my skin feel so hydrated. It's wonderful.
I love the awesome moisturized feeling that the Hydra Mask Gel Cream provides at night. I apply a small amount on my face after the moisturizers and my skin just glows and feels so soft!

Between the cold weather and the stress in my life, my skin was paying the price. It was dry, flaking, cracking. This moisturizer saved the day! With daily use, and after only a few days I saw noticeable results. It's a nice, creamy finish, too - not greasy! 10 out of 10!!
My skin feels so refreshed and hydrated in the morning. I'm really liking this new part of my skin care routine.
I have been using the cream for 2 weeks and I do think it makes my skin look more hydrated in the morning.

I hate liking new things because that just means I spend more money, but I do like this product (and I don't like them all)! It's not oily or sticky like the hydrating serum but it does moisturize and leave my skin looking fresh and dare I say younger? I tried the hydrating serum first and while it gives that shiny appearance I also found it to be a little tacky as it dried. Luckily I found the gel to use instead.

avis.titre: Hydra mask gel cream is a winner!
avis.texte: I could tell a difference in one day. My skin was very dry. This product really helps.
Has a lighter cell than some mask and my skin felt refreshed in the morning.

avis.titre: Love the Hydro Mask Gel Cream
avis.texte: I love the feel and pleasant smell. It truly does hydrate your skin and I see and feel the difference in just a few uses.
I used before bed, feels light and applies smoothly. Face feels refreshed and hydrated the next morning.
I use this every day. . . so yes I truly believe this is a very good product
Easy to apply. Loved the texture. It absorbed quickly didn't feel tacky or sticky. My skin felt soft and smooth the next morning.

avis.titre: Love the new hydra mask gel cream!
avis.texte: Smooth and lightweight and super-moisturizing for my face. It smells good, too!
It is my favorite because is perfect for hydration especially during the winter.
This is very hydrating overnight. But to soon to tell the ROI. Has helped to minimize my routine which is what I was looking for.

Lost a good amount of the product when first opening the jar due to its adherence to the lid. It applies smoothly and seems to hydrate well when used. However, I typically turn to other hydrating serums to avoid the mess encountered if you don't open the jar on a level surface.
My face feels so fresh and smooth every moning after I apply before bed
Excellent product. My skin is noticeably softer and mor hydrated the next day after using the Hydra mask Gel.
I like the way it feels and how my face feels in the morning.
A with all R & F products this one is really good. Very comforting to my skin.
I love the gel cream. Goes on smooth and you can feel it hydrating your skin. Excellent product.
This product smells wonderful and is nice on my skin. While the instructions say to use twice a day, I find it to be too heavy under makeup. I do use it at night with the RF Vitamin C serum.
Love it! It's the perfect combination of moisturizer. It's light and not overly greasy.
I love how the hydration mask feels on my face. It is not oily but truly hydrating.

avis.titre: hydra mask gel cream and Pure C serum
avis.texte: I love both products. I Put the mask on before bedtime and it keeps the moisture working all night. I also love the Pure C serum. So creamy under my foundation.
I look forward to applying this cream every night! It feels refreshing and hydrates my skin. I like to apply it to the back of my hands, too.
Hydra Mask Gel Cream makes my skin feel nice and gives it a great glow. I don't see a lot of results other than that.
I love the way my face feels after using this product. And I don't have to use much at all. It goes a long way.
I have noticed such a difference in the texture of my skin since using this. Its a must in my nighly routine.

I absolutely love the Hydra Mask Gel Cream. It feels so good when applied to my clean face before bed. It glides on smoothly and has a bit of a cooling sensation. When I wake up in the morning, my face is glowing and supple. I will definitely be repurchasing this in the future. Thank you!!
My skin loves the gel cream mask! I sleep with it on and wake up with a lovely, happy face!!!
This gel cream is smooth and cooling. I have noticed lessening of my wrinkles. It's so nice. I look forward to my evening routine.
This gel cream is amazing! I've never used another product that moisturizes, has the silkiest texture and actually works! I will keep ordering for sure.
My skin was dry and sensitive from using tretinoin. This did help with the dryness after a couple uses.
I love this product too. It is a jel and I was leary of it. All other jels I have tried turned out to be sticky, which ai will wash off. Not this one at all. Absorbs in great.

Great if you get too much sun. After a hot shower when your pores are open, put a layer of mask on and leave it. It'll be absorbed. It's a great addition for those with drier skin. Some will use all year. Some will need during colder weather.
Make my skincare routine better. My skin has never felt this good
Love the way this cream leaves my skin feeling hydrated without be overly greasy feeling. Absorbs so nicely.
I thought this would help more, but didn't notice a big difference.
I love this gel!! It makes my skin feel so good in the morning.

I love the Hydra Gel Cream! It's like whipped translucent ice. A little goes a long way. I did receive as a promotional gift (full size) and my not have purchased on my own, but it's totally won me over!
I look forward to this in my nightly routine. It goes on so smooth and my skin feels hydrated and so soft in the morning!

avis.titre: Feels great on my face but the smell is too strong
avis.texte: I like how it feels on my skin but the smell is so strong I'm unable to use it.
Got this cream for free with an order. I will definitely be purchasing it!
Love to put this on before bed and wake up hydrated!!! I use both summer and winter without a problem.
Love this gel cream for overnight use. I would definitely buy again.
I lovethe hydrogel cream. I put it in every night. I can tell a difference in my face.
I love this product! It makes my face feel clean, fresh and cool.
I like the feel of my skin once I put the mask on my skin. It feels even more amazing in the morning when I splash water on my skin to wake it up:)

avis.titre: I love R+F's Hydra Mask Gel Cream
avis.texte: I have been using the Hydra Mask Gel Cream since it was first released a few years ago. It is one of my favorite products. Ultra soothing and moisturizing. Goes on very smoothly and absorbs really well. I love to apply it in the evening after cleansing and using the derma roller.
Goes on smooth and can use day or night even though it says at night. One of my favorite products.
Love how it goes on. There is a very nice cooling effect. Definitely feel hydrated and fine lines are basically gone!!!:relaxed:
My skin felt plumped and well hydrated after using the gel cream.
Love the way my skin looks and feels when I use the Hydra Mask Gel at night.
I love how may skin feels so soft when I wake up in the morning.
I've seen a real improvement in my skin since using this line—smoother, brighter, and more hydrated. Highly recommend!
I like this new product. The gel has made my skin softer than the other night creams and I use it with the new Serum with C

avis.titre: Love the hydra mask gel cream
avis.texte: I apply it once or twice a week after using my regimen and it makes my skin feel like I just had a facial.
The cream feels really nice on my skin and I think my complexion is improving with use.
I LOVE this mask and the way my face looks fresh and hydrated in the mornings- I use it at night and leave it on and it's so soft in the mornings.
Really like it! Very hydrating and sometimes even use it in the morning as my face cream!
